title: Unauthenticated API Endpoints Allow Uncontrolled LLM Token Consumption
evidence: All routes in services/api/foresight_api/main.py are exposed without dependencies or authorization checks. A POST to /api/sessions/{session_id}/agent/runs invokes the external Meta or Fireworks API directly.
reproduction_steps: Send 'curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/diagnostics/model-check' or 'curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/sessions/{id}/agent/runs' without any authentication headers. Request executes and consumes tokens.
recommended_fix: Add API key or Bearer token authentication middleware for state-mutating and LLM-triggering endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated requests to POST /api/sessions/{id}/agent/runs return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

title: Fixed Session Cap Without Eviction Enables Trivial DoS
evidence: MAX_SESSIONS is hardcoded to 20. SessionManager.create() raises SessionError('Too many active sessions; delete one first') if len(self.sessions) >= MAX_SESSIONS without evicting idle sessions.
reproduction_steps: Execute 20 consecutive 'POST /api/sessions' calls. The 21st call fails with HTTP 409.
recommended_fix: Implement LRU eviction: when self.sessions reaches MAX_SESSIONS, delete the session with the oldest last_active timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: 25 consecutive session creation requests succeed without HTTP 409 errors; exactly 20 sessions remain active.

title: 16-Member Confirmation Ensemble Has Statistical Tail-Risk Blind Spot
evidence: Documented in artifacts/reports/redteam_v4.md: Meta Muse Spark discovered a 'Reduce load by 35%' proposal for bearing deterioration that passed 16-member confirmation (0 failures) but failed 1/48 in the audit ensemble across all 3 rounds.
reproduction_steps: Run scripts/run_red_team.py with verifier v4 and Meta high attacker on bearing_deterioration@120min/s7.
recommended_fix: Increase confirmation ensemble size from 16 to 32 members, or enforce an adaptive confirmation size when Wilson upper bound on failure incidence is > 0.05.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/run_red_team.py reports 0 hard escapes on bearing_deterioration@120min/s7.

title: Non-Atomic Check-Then-Set Pattern on LiveSession.busy
evidence: LiveSession checks 'if self.busy:' and then sets 'self.busy = ...' across async context transitions without an asyncio.Lock, allowing concurrent requests to enter mutating methods simultaneously.
reproduction_steps: Dispatch two simultaneous HTTP requests to /api/sessions/{id}/agent/runs and /api/sessions/{id}/futures at the exact same millisecond.
recommended_fix: Introduce asyncio.Lock() to guard session state transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent requests to mutating endpoints are strictly serialized without race conditions.

title: Volatile In-Memory Session Storage Causes State Loss on Restart
evidence: SessionManager stores all LiveSession objects in a memory dictionary. When the FastAPI process terminates or restarts, all active sessions, simulation histories, and agent traces are lost.
reproduction_steps: Create a session, run an agent diagnosis, then restart the Uvicorn server. GET /api/sessions/{id} returns HTTP 404.
recommended_fix: Persist session metadata and completed agent traces to an embedded SQLite database using aiosqlite.
acceptance_criteria: Active session metadata and historical agent runs survive server process restarts.

title: Windows UV Trampoline Script Canonicalization Failure
evidence: Running 'uv run pytest' in Windows PowerShell fails with 'error: uv trampoline failed to canonicalize script path'. Direct invocation via '.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest' succeeds.
reproduction_steps: Open Windows PowerShell in repository root and run 'uv run pytest'. Observe error.
recommended_fix: Document '.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest' in README.md as the recommended Windows test execution command, or upgrade uv.
acceptance_criteria: Test execution command documented in README runs cleanly out-of-the-box on Windows.

title: Open-Weights Model Hallucinates Unknown Evidence IDs in Hypotheses
evidence: Documented in artifacts/reports/evaluation.md: Fireworks Muse Spark Open generated 44 unknown evidence IDs across 2 of 14 runs during the v4 benchmark. Although caught and filtered before final recommendation, the hypothesis text contained hallucinated references.
reproduction_steps: Inspect artifacts/reports/evaluation.md line 346; run live evaluation with Fireworks provider.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit few-shot example in HYPOTHESIS_TASK showing valid vs invalid evidence IDs and instruct the model that invalid IDs are penalized.
acceptance_criteria: Hallucinated evidence ID count on Fireworks Muse Spark Open drops to 0 across 14 test runs.

title: Simple Alarm Rule Achieves Lower Mean Cost Than Autonomous Agent
evidence: In closed-loop evaluation (seeds 2000-2004), rule_inspect_on_alarm achieved $1,472 mean cost vs foresight_active's $1,647. The rule immediately inspects upon threshold breach, while the agent attempts multi-step operational derating first.
reproduction_steps: Review closed-loop benchmark results in artifacts/reports/evaluation.md Section 5.
recommended_fix: Highlight this finding in submission documentation: explain that immediate inspection is only cheaper when restart/downtime costs are low and continuous operations permit stopping.
acceptance_criteria: Submission documentation clearly articulates the operational trade-off between threshold inspection and counterfactual derating.
